edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: Both assertions refer to the same Conservative Party plan to cut spending by £47bn and are found in the same source article. The NEW assertion refers to Badenoch's previous outline of the same figure mentioned by Griffith in the EXISTING assertion.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-03, The Guardian reported “Last October, Griffith said: “There are decisions made and signed up to by everybody to deliver that £47bn. Last week at the shadow cabinet, we talked about [how] we will need to go further.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “Kemi Badenoch has previously outlined how the government would cut government spending by £47bn, mainly by cutting welfare spending for all non-British or EU citizens.”.
